title: How one Spotify product manager cut AI coding costs by 90% by making cheaper models do the grunt work - CNBC TV18
summary: Spotify product manager cut AI coding costs by 90 percent using cheaper models
detailed: 💻 A Spotify product manager reduced AI coding costs by 90% by routing routine tasks to cheaper models. 🔍 The approach uses smaller models for file reading and repetitive code, while reserving powerful models for complex problems. ✍️ Asmi Saxena explains how the strategy works. https://lnkd.in/gdH6m9fN #AI #Coding #ArtificialIntelligence #Tech #CNBCTV18
